title: 第508章 他竟然能靠近两仪婆娑树第507章 两仪婆娑树把温郗吞了
slug: 开局逼我献祭我有天道赐福
content_zh:
第508章他竟然能靠近两仪婆娑树！
总觉得这神树很诡异，萧杙转身想走，面前却又出现了一层金色屏障。
萧杙：？
两仪婆娑树的枝叶又晃了晃，“啪嗒”，一根断枝掉落在了萧杙面前。
那截枝干约莫两指粗细，枝叶茂密，砸落在地上时还掉了几片蓝绿两色的叶子，周身有星星点点的金光缠绕。
萧杙沉默了一瞬，微微蹙眉，上前弯腰捡起了那截枝干，只是心中总隐隐有不好的预感。
当萧杙指尖触碰到两仪婆娑树枝干的刹那，一股热流自他指尖径直钻入他的体内，流过四肢百骸，让人心中不由得一颤。
萧杙顿了顿，将枝干握于掌心，缓缓直起了腰身。
他立在两仪婆娑树下，清风吹过，落叶携着点点金光拂过他的脸庞。风在经过萧杙时似乎都放缓了速度，格外温和，落叶也温和。
萧杙站在那，心中破天荒地感受到了几分平静。
他敛下眼眸，长睫微颤，该说不愧是启明洲圣物吗？
站在两仪婆娑树下良久，萧杙定定地望着那黑白两色相互纠缠缠绕的树干，莫名抬起了手，轻轻抚过祂的树干。
粗糙的质感让萧杙回过神来，下意识唤出了裁妄剑。
以启明洲众人的认知来说，他既非岱舆温氏之人，又没见过两仪婆娑树几次，这样冒然相碰，只怕下一秒就要被打飞了。
可偏偏等了许久，无事发生。
诶？萧杙懵了。
按照温征所言，按照启明洲的惯例，此刻两仪婆娑树难道不应该狠狠把他扇飞出去或者拿枝条抽他几巴掌吗？
萧杙皱起眉，只觉得从他今日踏上岱舆山开始，就各种怪事频发。
先是小郗被这巨树吞进身体，又被神树拽到这边用各种看似亲密的呼唤吸引他，现在更是对他的触碰视若无睹。
萧杙实在想不明白这两仪婆娑树究竟要做什么，不信邪地又敲了敲神树的树干。

还是，无事发生。
两仪婆娑树的枝叶甚至又晃了晃，像极了一个毛绒团子在扭动。
萧杙抬眉，更诡异了。
——————————
另一边，温征好不容易喘匀了气，再次爬上山顶，入目就是这一幕——
萧杙站在两仪婆娑树下，一手在那“咚咚咚”敲着神树的树干，头发和身上还沾着好几片落叶。
而且，毫发无伤！
温征努力了数百年都没做到的事情，让萧杙一个别人家的孩子做到了。
只一秒，温征的呼吸瞬间变得急促，周身灵力暴动，掀起阵阵狂风。
“你这小儿！竟妄图接近我岱舆温氏神树！竖子尔敢！”温征撸起了袖子，面色气到涨红，“哇呀呀呀呀呀，老夫今日高低让你长长教训！”
第508章他竟然能靠近两仪婆娑树！
萧杙转过身，语气无奈：“温长老，此事并非我本意。”
萧杙这一转身不要紧，倒是叫温征看到了他手里两仪婆娑树的那节断枝。
content_en:
Chapter 508 He can actually get close to the Liangyi Whirling Tree!
Always feeling that this sacred tree was weird, Xiao Yao turned around and wanted to leave, but another golden barrier appeared in front of him.
Xiao Zhu:?
The branches and leaves of the Liangyi whirling tree swayed again, and with a "click", a broken branch fell in front of Xiao Zhu.
The branch was about the thickness of two fingers, with dense branches and leaves. When it fell to the ground, a few blue and green leaves fell off, and there were dots of golden light around it.
Xiao Yao was silent for a moment, frowned slightly, stepped forward and bent down to pick up the branch, but there was always a bad feeling in his heart.
The moment Xiao Zhu's fingertips touched the whirling branches of Liangyi, a stream of heat penetrated directly into his body from his fingertips and flowed through his limbs and bones, making people tremble in their hearts.
Xiao Zhu paused, held the branch in his palm, and slowly straightened his waist.
He stood under the dancing tree of Liangyi, with the breeze blowing, and the fallen leaves carrying little golden light brushed his face. The wind seemed to slow down as it passed through Xiao Zhu, becoming exceptionally gentle, and the falling leaves were also gentle.
Xiao Zhu stood there, feeling a bit calm for the first time in his heart.
He lowered his eyes and his long eyelashes trembled slightly. Should it be said that it was worthy of being a sacred object of Qimingzhou?
After standing under the whirling tree of Liangyi for a long time, Xiao Yao stared intently at the entangled black and white tree trunk. He inexplicably raised his hand and gently stroked its trunk.
The rough texture brought Xiao Yao back to his senses, and he subconsciously summoned the Juewang Sword.
According to the knowledge of everyone in Qimingzhou, he is neither a member of the Daiyu Wen family, nor has he seen the Liangyi whistling tree a few times. If he bumps into it so rashly, he is afraid that he will be blown away in the next second.
But after waiting for a long time, nothing happened.
Eh? Xiao Zhu was stunned.
According to what Wen Zheng said, and according to Qimingzhou's practice, shouldn't the Liangyi whistling tree slap him away at this moment or slap him with a branch?
Xiao Zhu frowned and felt that since he set foot on Daiyu Mountain today, all kinds of strange things have happened frequently.
First, Xiao Xi was swallowed into the body by the giant tree, and then he was dragged here by the sacred tree and attracted him with various seemingly intimate calls. Now he turned a blind eye to his touch.
Xiao Zhu really couldn't figure out what the two Yi whirling trees were going to do, so he knocked on the trunk of the sacred tree again in disbelief.
Still, nothing happened.
The branches and leaves of the Liangyi whirling tree even swayed again, like a stuffed ball twisting.
Xiao Zhu raised his eyebrows, feeling even more weird.
——————————
On the other side, Wen Zheng finally took a breath and climbed to the top of the mountain again. This was the scene he saw——
Xiao Zhu stood under the whirling tree of Liangyi, tapping the trunk of the sacred tree with one hand, with several fallen leaves still stuck to his hair and body.
And, unscathed!
What Wen Zheng had tried hard for hundreds of years and failed to do was allowed to be done by Xiao Zhu, a child from another family.
In just one second, Wen Zheng's breathing suddenly became rapid, and the spiritual energy around him exploded, setting off gusts of wind.
"You kid! You are trying to get close to my Daiyu Wen family's sacred tree! How dare you!" Wen Zheng rolled up his sleeves, his face turned red with anger, "Wow, wow, wow, I'm going to teach you a lesson today!"
Chapter 508 He can actually get close to the Liangyi Whirling Tree!
Xiao Zhu turned around and said helplessly: "Elder Wen, this was not my intention."
It didn't matter that Xiao Zhu turned around, but Wen Zheng saw the broken branch of the Liangyi whirling tree in his hand.
